root_causes_addressed: A valid five-day plan could lose the final return-day geometry during live enrichment; the map then rendered only four day segments.
The rejected-variant path called showView('planner'), but the real view id is plannerView.
The planner had only one trip structure: the roadtrip hard rules rejected deliberate single-base holidays as invalid repeated nights.
There was no explicit base-selection optimisation; legacy stay logic could use a destination base without proving it was the best hub for the user's criteria and reachable day trips.

new_behavior.moving: Roadtrip — every overnight progresses to a different place; existing >=50 km and distinct-night rules remain.
new_behavior.base: One intelligent base. Day 1 travels to the base, middle days are distinct round trips from that base, final day returns home.
new_behavior.base_scoring: Scores preference match, POI richness, vehicle suitability, centrality/reachable day-trip count, destination-anchor proximity and outbound comfort.
new_behavior.map: Every outward/transfer/return day is guaranteed drawable geometry; base day trips are base -> target -> base.

results.name: Base choice is criteria-driven not nearest only

limitations: Public live routing/discovery providers are not executable from this sandbox. Production policy, base selection, day-trip selection, validation and the exact route-geometry repair function were executed locally.
